subject.title: Feishu card action: pass through form_value, input_value and other fields

question: What agent-visible payload contract should Feishu card actions expose for `form_value`, `input_value`, `option`, `options`, and `name`?
rationale: The missing fields are source-reproducible and part of Feishu's callback payload, but choosing JSON passthrough versus command-text appending changes channel behavior that existing button-command flows depend on.

options.title: Structured passthrough
options.body: Expose non-button callback fields as structured JSON while keeping simple button command/text extraction unchanged.

options.title: Command-text append
options.body: Append callback fields to the existing command text if maintainers accept ordering, quoting, and value-serialization rules for downstream parsers.

options.title: Narrow form-first fix
options.body: Ship only `form_value` first and leave selector, input, and name passthrough to a follow-up contract decision.

recommendation.title: Structured passthrough
recommendation.body: Expose non-button callback fields as structured JSON while keeping simple button command/text extraction unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: The Feishu package metadata names this handle as the community-maintained plugin contact, and this decision is specific to the Feishu channel payload contract.
